Hazel K: Quick post-sim note: EU tenant commits showed up in us-central for ~12s during a partition. Control plane still listed EU as custody. Not good.
Tom B: Was sidecar doing a local promote? sequence?
Hazel K: Yes. Heartbeat gap -> sidecar did local promote -> accepted writes -> partition healed -> control plane later reconciled back to EU. No cross-region consent.
Ibrahim N: I think we should design a two-phase custody handoff: 1) custody-token issuance (signed by current custody region) 2) custody-commit/confirm which either promotes or quarantines.
Tom B: Token idea: custody token carries tenant_id, custody_region, issue_ts, ttl, seq, consent_flag, signature. Short TTL (5-15s) for cross-region. Example header:
```
X-Custody-Token: eyJraWQiOiJldS0xIiwi...
X-Custody-Seq: 0000000007
X-Custody-TTL: 15s
```
Ibrahim N: Implementation: dataplane validates token sig against control-plane PKI, checks seq > persisted_watermark, if cross-region then either call witness endpoint or write with a "visibility_tombstone" marker so global reads hide until confirm.
Hazel K: Visibility tombstone = quarantine flag that keeps the write local-visible only; control-plane confirm flips tombstone to visible. This keeps availability but prevents leak.
Tom B: Tradeoffs: tombstone preserves safety but breaks global RYW. We'll need an opt-in tenant flag for relaxed semantics.
Ibrahim N: Replay/rollback: persist watermark per-tenant so if node restarts we reject tokens with seq <= watermark. For KMS rotation, include key_epoch in token and fetch keyring.
LegalBot: Legal needs these token claims: tenant_id, custody_region, signed_time, claim_of_residency, operator_override_audit_id if present. Tokens must be provable in audits.
Hazel K: Ops notes: operator break-glass flow should produce a two-key signature (2FA) and generate an override token with explicit consent claim and retained audit trail.
Tom B: Monitoring: emit custody-token events to audit stream and create an alert if a cross-region token is accepted without witness confirmation.
Ibrahim N: Next steps: I can PoC sidecar token verify + tombstone semantics. Hazel can draft RFC with token schema + opt-in flags + operator override. Tom will sketch telemetry and alarms.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-7190: "custody-token-two-phase-poc" and linked runbook docs.
Hazel K: Aim to gate automatic cross-region commits behind explicit tenant consent and default to tombstone+confirm for cross-region until legal signs off. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
